title: File a slice from a note or a request in ork

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Closes parity row 1.7 and the "File a slice from a note or a request" gap (docs/orchestrator-parity.md, section 1; the Prioritized gaps table, gap 5). New slices are the main bookkeeping the outer session does. ork files a slice only from a run's later finding (`FileLater`, `internal/engine/later.go:82-121`; `f` in the run pane; `ork file RUN N`). A slice that did not come from a run has no path in ork.

Owner decision 2026-10-29: this gap is v1.0 (everything except S173, S179 and S180 is).

Facts checked on 2026-10-29:
- The two slicer calls exist as client functions: `Client.Add` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:255-270`) and `Client.Promote` (`write.go:272-278`). `Add` always passes `--discovered-from` and takes no size or scores, so a request that has no source item needs a new function beside it.
- In a scratch slicer project (`.scratch/specs/sandbox`): `slicer add TITLE --size M --importance 2 --key K --json --lean` files an item; the same `--key` again returns `"existing":true` and the item unchanged; `--discovered-from ""` is accepted; `slicer promote ID --file OUTLINE` with a Why-only outline gives a slice whose other sections are empty. slicer prints a warning on stderr for an item with no scores; ork ignores stderr.
- A note is a string in `slicercli.Item.Notes` ("**DATE** - text"), returned by `slicer show ID --json --lean` (`Client.Show`, `internal/slicercli/slicercli.go:68-74`).
- slicer already has the capability in its own CLI and `slicer tui` (slicer S50, S63, done). ork calls the CLI and does not reimplement it. ork never opens or edits tracking files (`AGENTS.md`, Tracking).
- A filed slice is thin: Why only. The Roadmap marks any open slice with a slice file and no unmet dependency as ready (`readySlice`, `internal/tui/roadmap.go:278`), so the new row may show as ready. The same holds for `FileLater` today. S167 (spec check on a single-slice launch) is what stops a thin slice from running. This slice does not change readiness.

Decided records that apply: `scope.v1` (#1) says roadmap and decision editing wait for a later version, and `ui.slicer-tui` (#11) says common edits live in ork. The owner's 2026-10-29 decision moves this gap into v1.0. The owner records that against #1 (ork never runs `adj reject` or `adj supersede`).

What this slice adds (all *proposed* until an adj record decides it):
- `ork new PROJECT TITLE [--why TEXT|-] [--from ITEM] [--from-note N] [--size S|M|L] [--importance N] [--urgency N] [--effort N] [--json]`. `--why -` reads stdin. `--from-note N` (one-based) needs `--from ITEM`: ork reads that item's note N through `slicer show` and quotes it in the Why section. Prints `filed S184 (title)`; for a retry of the same request, `S184 is already filed`.
- Daemon method `item.new` (params `{project,title,why,from,from_note,size,importance,urgency,effort}`, result `{id,existing}`). The daemon runs `slicer add` then `slicer promote` and reads Items and Deps again.
- `engine.FileNewSlice` in `internal/engine/newslice.go` (new), a package function beside `RecordSpecAnswers` (`internal/engine/speccheck.go:348`) because no run is involved.
- Roadmap key `n`: a form with Title and Why fields (`tab` switches, `enter` sends, `esc` cancels). From the item pane the form files a slice discovered from that item. The form is the owner's confirmation; there is no second prompt (see Open 2).
- The filing key is `ork-new-` plus the first 16 hex digits of a SHA-256 of project path, title, why and source. The same request sent twice returns the first slice instead of filing a duplicate. A changed title or Why files a new slice.

Depends on S171 (add a note to a slice), which creates `internal/tui/compose.go` and the `item.*` daemon pattern. Run S170 after S171.

Not in this slice: setting the other sections (Files, Failing tests, Implement, Check; that is S179, v1.1), dependencies, passes and the scoring of a request by a role, picking a note by key in the TUI (Open 1), and filing into a project other than the selected one.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestAddItemArguments` (`internal/slicercli/add_test.go`): `AddItem` builds `add TITLE --key K --size M --importance 2 --urgency 2 --effort 1 --render --json --lean --root R`, leaves out every flag whose value is empty or 0 (so no `--discovered-from` for a request), cuts a leading dash from the title, and needs an id in the output.
- `TestFileNewSliceAddsThenPromotesAWhySection` (`internal/engine/newslice_test.go`): one `add` then one `promote` with an outline file that holds `## TITLE`, `### Why` and the owner's text; the temporary file is gone afterwards; the result carries the new id.
- `TestFileNewSliceFromANoteQuotesIt` (`internal/engine/newslice_test.go`): with `FromNote: 2` the engine reads the item through `show`, quotes note 2 in the Why section and names the source item; the add call carries `--discovered-from ITEM`.
- `TestFileNewSliceRefusals` (`internal/engine/newslice_test.go`): blank title, `FromNote` without `From`, a note number past the item's notes, a score outside 1-3, and a multi-line title are refused before any write.
- `TestFileNewSliceRetryDoesNotPromoteTwice` (`internal/engine/newslice_test.go`): the same request twice gives the same key; when slicer answers `existing` with `has_slice`, no promote runs and the result says `existing`. A promote failure after a successful add returns an error that names the new id, and the retry then promotes it.
- `TestItemNewFilesASliceAndReadsItemsAgain` (`internal/daemon/items_test.go`): `item.new` runs add and promote against the project root and refreshes Items and Deps; subtests for blank title, unknown project, unknown field (`bad_params` or `not_found`) and a slicer error code that reaches the caller.
- `TestNewCommandFilesASlice` (`internal/cli/new_test.go`): `ork new P "Title" --why - --from S12 --size M` sends the stdin text with the right params and prints `filed S184`; `--json` prints `{"id":"S184","existing":false}`; an `existing` reply prints `S184 is already filed`.
- `TestNewCommandUsage` (`internal/cli/new_test.go`): no title, `--from-note` without `--from`, a non-number note, and a score outside 1-3 exit 2 before the daemon is dialed.
- `TestRoadmapNewFormSendsTitleAndWhy` (`internal/tui/compose_test.go`): `n` opens the two-field form, `tab` moves to Why, `enter` sends once with project, title and why and no source item; a blank title keeps the form open with "A slice needs a title"; `esc` closes it with no write; the status then says `Filed S184` and the project is fetched.
- `TestRoadmapNewFromTheItemPaneSetsTheSource` (`internal/tui/compose_test.go`): `n` inside the open item pane sends `From` set to that item; `+`, `-`, `q` and digits type into the form.
- `TestHintBarOffersNewOnTheRoadmap` (`internal/tui/hint_test.go`): the Roadmap list and item pane hints list `n new slice` only with a daemon and a selected project; the form's own hint lists `tab field`, `enter send`, `esc cancel`.
- `TestGoldenRoadmapNew` (`internal/tui/compose_test.go`): the two-field form at 100x30, colour and mono.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14). It touches `internal/tui`, `docs/dashboard.md` and `internal/cli` output. Write the failing tests above first. Run after S171.

1. `internal/slicercli/write.go:247-284`: add `AddSpec{Title, DiscoveredFrom, Key, Size string; Importance, Urgency, Effort int}` and `Client.AddItem(ctx, w, root, spec) (*Added, error)`. It builds the argv from the non-empty fields only, cuts a leading `- ` from the title as `Add` does (`write.go:260`), and decodes the result as `Add` does. Leave `Add` and `FileLater` alone.
2. `internal/engine/newslice.go` (new, SPDX line first): `NewSliceConfig{Project registry.Project; Title, Why, From string; FromNote int; Size string; Importance, Urgency, Effort int; TempDir string}` and `FileNewSlice(ctx, d Deps, cfg) (id string, existing bool, err error)`. Validate first: title is one line (`strings.Fields` join), `FromNote > 0` needs `From`, scores are 0 or 1-3. With `FromNote`, call `d.Slicer.Show(ctx, root, From)` (`slicercli.go:68-74`) and take `Detail.Notes[FromNote-1]`. Why text: the owner's `Why`, else the quoted note, else the line "Filed in ork on DATE. No description was given." (use `d.now()`); when `From` is set add "Discovered from FROM." Key: `"ork-new-" + first 16 hex digits of sha256(root, title, why, from, note number)`. Then `AddItem`; if `Existing && HasSlice` return it with `existing=true` (as `later.go:107-110`); else write the outline `## TITLE\n\n### Why\n\nTEXT\n` to `os.CreateTemp(cfg.TempDir, "new-*.md")`, mode 0600, `Promote` it, and remove the file in a defer (the pattern is `later.go:111-118`). A promote failure returns "filed ID, but its Why section failed (filing again retries it): ..." as `later.go:118` does. Use `runrec.Writer{Now: d.now, Sleep: d.Sleep, Backoff: d.Backoff}` with no Sink, as `RecordSpecAnswers` does (`speccheck.go:373`).
3. `internal/daemon/wire.go:17-33` and `:289-298`: `MethodItemNew = "item.new"` (*proposed*), `ItemNewParams`, `ItemNewResult{ID string; Existing bool}`. `internal/daemon/items.go`: `itemNew` like S171's `itemNote`: `badParams` for a blank title, `d.registered`, `engine.FileNewSlice(ctx, d.runDeps(proj), cfg)` with `TempDir: d.cfg.Paths.Dir`, then `d.cache.Refresh(ctx, proj, source.Items, source.Deps)`. Case in `handlers.go:121-126`; `Client.ItemNew` in `client.go:213-219`'s neighbourhood.
4. `internal/cli/new.go` (new): `ork new` with the flags in Why. Check `--from-note` needs `--from`, parse numbers, read stdin for `--why -`; exit 2 on usage errors before `a.call` (`run.go:19`). Text output `filed ID` or `ID is already filed`. Usage text and dispatch: `cli.go:40-77`, `cli.go:173-205`.
5. `internal/tui`: add `itemFiler { ItemNew(ctx, params daemon.ItemNewParams) (daemon.ItemNewResult, error) }` as an optional interface beside S171's `itemNoter`; `Daemon.ItemNew` beside `ItemShow` (`daemon.go:99-107`). Extend `composeState` (S171) with `kind == composeNew`: two `textField`s and a focus index. `tab`/`shift+tab` switch; `enter` sends; blank title stays open. `openNew()` shares `noteRefusal`'s checks (rename it `composeRefusal`). From the item pane, set `From` to `m.itemPane.id`; from the list leave it empty. Keys: `New key.Binding` (`n`) in `keys.go:14-63`, `FullHelp`, the Roadmap hints (`keys.go:344-353`), dispatch beside `Launch` (`model.go:637-641`). `n` stays "no" inside a confirmation because `m.confirm` is handled first (`model.go:507-521`). `projectTextEntry` (`projects.go:23-27`) already covers `m.compose` from S171.
6. After a send: status `Filed ID` (or `ID is already filed`), `m.fetch(project, true)` (`model.go:292-306`). The new row shows where slicer's order puts it.
7. Update `TestRoadmapWritesNothing` (`roadmap_test.go:163-188`): it presses `n` today; keep the zero-write assertion, and add that the form never writes without `enter` on a non-blank title.
8. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md:1275-1331` (the `n` form, the line "Editing comes after v1" now names notes and new slices as the v1.0 edits), `docs/design.md:1205-1240` (the `new` command and `item.new`), `docs/manual-steps.md:39-56` (the "Still manual" row for filing). Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui -update`, then read the diff in `testdata/golden/`; only the two new `roadmap-new-*` files change.

Order: after S171 (shares `compose.go`, the `item.*` handlers and the Roadmap key block). S172, S174 and S178 do not share files with this slice except `cli.go` (usage text) and `keys.go`; merge main before the gate.

Open (for the owner; the defaults below are what the steps above implement):
1. How does the TUI file from an existing note? Options: (A) the CLI only, `--from-note` (default; recommended: smallest, the pane lists notes after S171); (B) in the item pane, digit keys select a note and `n` quotes it; (C) `n` in the pane prefills Why with the newest note. 
2. Does filing need a confirm step before the write? Options: (A) no, the typed command or the submitted form is the owner's act (default; recommended); (B) a `[y/N]` prompt in both surfaces, like `ork run`.
